weighting: 2 ** (-age_years / half_life_years); age from forecast_time to start of outer calibration year, with 365.25 days/year. Normalize to mean 1 separately in each training class, preserving both class weight totals.
training: Replace only XGBoost in fixed 0.45 logistic / 0.55 XGBoost ensemble; unchanged 96 features and base hyperparameters; all training rows retained.
calibration: Each tree refits sigmoid on the original calibration year; ensemble threshold chosen there at recall >=0.95 and frozen before evaluation.
selection: No evaluation-based winner selection or half-life tuning. Report both fixed candidates against baseline per year.
acceptance: For each fixed candidate require higher precision, recall >=0.95, AP no lower, Brier/log loss no higher in every comparable positive year. Complete original coverage required. No automatic promotion.
limitations: Adaptive retrospective development informed by past evaluation findings; not independent testing.
Temporal weighting may reduce effective information from old positive regions and worsen recall or calibration.
Within-class normalization controls class-weight totals but does not remove distribution shift or prove its cause.
